text: The model has identified a pituitary region abnormality on the brain MRI. This classification reflects that the appearance of a lesion is consistent with a tumour arising in the sellar region, most commonly an adenoma, and it does not constitute a definitive diagnosis [ncbi-pituitary-adenoma-statpearls] [nci-pituitary-pdq]. The algorithm evaluates only the imaging appearance and cannot assess hormonal activity or compression of the optic chiasm, both of which are central to clinical management [nci-pituitary-pdq] [ncbi-pituitary-adenoma-statpearls]. Consequently, the finding should be discussed with a qualified clinician as the first step in an endocrine and ophthalmological work-up. Relevant matters to consider include a clinical examination for endocrine symptoms, comprehensive pituitary hormone testing, formal visual-field assessment, and a dedicated pituitary-protocol MRI, together with specialist review by endocrinology, neurosurgery and, where appropriate, ophthalmology or neuro-ophthalmology [ncbi-pituitary-adenoma-statpearls] [nci-pituitary-diagnosis]. Prompt medical assessment is advised if the patient experiences sudden severe headache, rapid visual change, double vision, altered consciousness or signs of acute adrenal insufficiency [nci-pituitary-pdq] [ninds-brain-tumors].
